Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Glazed Ceramic Table Lamp, 19"H, Dark Blue
Colors: Dark Blue
Materials: ceramic
This ceramic lamp's textured pattern with a glossy dark-blue glazed finish has a true classic look that will add a touch of sophistication to any room. 9"W x 9"D x 19"H Dark-blue textured reactive glazed ceramic base; brushed-nickel accents; off-white linen drum shade This bold ceramic lamp is paired with an off-white linen drum shade to cast perfect ambient light. Includes 1 60-watt equivalent LED bulb included
